svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank shaft: saw 30 bar 512 long; chamfer the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank arm: 40 x 10 flat bar, holes 280 apart: 30 for the shaft,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 for the grip pin. Weld a 50 x 30 boss (bored 30) on the shaft hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the 12 grip pin (120 long) into the outer hole, square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the crank on the shaft end with its face 20 in from the end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 6 through boss and shaft together; roll pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ratchet goes on the same shaft 150 from the crank (sheet 105).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the shaft turns in the two 30 bushes, 1000 above the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: crank arm square to the shaft; grip turns on its pin.
